notes.title: L&L update!
notes.notes:
Game changes and improvements

Something inside the central computers went astray, so access to the ODA is now 50% cheaper! This... malfunction will be fixed in a week.

A new eye implant for Adam was installed - now the game has full 2D lighting! It's both gameplay and visual feature, so we will use it both ways. At the moment, we have added lighting as a visual improvement to all levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35735220/ba89e7b56a1163b08eb6239753c7d3c20d6cb33d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35735220/6147f7e2452ad6d3a077d85b7606b85b9ba770af.png

The city's linguistic systems are expanding - we added German and Chinese language support!
It's always pleasure attract people from different cultures and countries. You are welcome.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35735220/6ddcd18a98d7565aeb88262ee4763ebaa82214b7.png

Changes in communication with community

We realised that weekly updates have a dubious meaning. It makes sense to speak when you really have something to say. We will work no less hard, but we will try to publish blogs and news that are of value to you.

We still appreciate any of your ideas and reports. It will not change.

Next plans

Adam moves on to save what is dear to him. Further, his path will run through dark places, and here in the dark he will receive his most unusual ability - impulse swap. You can guess what it is, but now we can't say more...

We are working hard on the mobile version for Android and iOS, so everyone can play the way they want. 

We will keep you in touch.

See you!

notes.title: Update 03/10
notes.notes:
Hello!
Here is the third news update.

Today we will talk about new level and what awaits you in it, tell you why we are adding Chinese language and complain a little about the life of inexperienced indie developers.

New level, mechanics and lighting

Having successfully implemented 2D lighting, we are now experimenting with how darkness and light can enrich our gameplay. We are trying to make the game with their help more entertaining and atmospheric, rather than more frustrating (Badly made dark levels are real nightmare!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35735220/713d558521c0ef84d98d5f7a7fb0e0b488059b47.png

Lighting effects have also been added to all existing levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35735220/f68298e9343a64b983564e6c86bc0b13689618cb.png

The new mechanics that we wrote about earlier is called “impulse swap", and it definitely has no less interesting usages than swap and wrap. Can you guess what it is by its name? Hint: the mechanics will be associated with all physical objects in the game world that Player can teleport.
“Impulse swap” is currently fully implemented and will first appear at new, sixth level.

New languages

We are happy to inform you that in the monthly October update we will add Chinese localization.

Asia has millions of players who are often unfairly ignored by many European developers. Chinese localization turned out to be the most accessible for us, but in the future we plan to localize the game for all players who are interested in it.

About us

This week was difficult for the whole team, and each member had its own reasons.

Nethertheless, we have enough energy and time for the most important thing - for developing our major update. This week, ODA will not receive another micropatch (However, we did not receive a single bug report).

All this week we were sending e-mails to various internet sites, trying to promote our game, but did not really succeed in it.

But we are not discouraged, and you should not too!

See you next week!

notes.title: Update 26/09
notes.notes:
Hello!
The second weekly update is here.

Today we will tell you about why we added a demo version, the latest fixes, our successes in social networks and how development is progressing.

 Demo version 
Wanting to be as honest as possible with the players and to find our players, we added a demo version available to everyone. You can find it at the store page in Steam, the button is located directly above the purchase button.
There are 2 levels available in demo version. All progress from the demo version will be saved when purchasing the full version of the game.

 Social networks 
We wrote a post about the history of our studio on DTF, and it seems to be interesting for people! Unfortunately, the post is available only in Russian, as we did not have enough time and resources to translate it.
Link to post: https://dtf.ru/gamedev/70779-istoriya-nashey-studii-v-kotoroy-byvalo-vsyakoe

 Patchnotes 

 Fixed a bug due to which it was possible to click on a menu item during an intro.
 Fixed a bug due to which fog in the background could not display correctly at non-standard screen resolutions.
 Removed closing the game by pressing ESC in the menu.
 Fixed incorrect starting camera position at the third level.


 What are we working on now 

 2D lighting. In fact, we have already implemented it, and now are actively testing and tuning so that in the middle of October you can get a new experience without any problems.
 Localization. The translation of the game into German is completed, and we are testing it for possible errors.
 New level. Still in progress, still has cool new stuff in it.


Do not forget about your important role - we need to know your opinion, ideas and problems! Participate in Steam discussions and feel free to contact us directly! 

That's all!
See you next week!
